author: __Jeebus__
body: I don't wish to bother anyone but I just want to know if there's any possibility of me getting unbanned! I made 2 appeals however no response was given to me. I would like to return playing while I have the time so if someone could please help me here, that would be great. Thanks!!

title: Appeals are being ignored

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello vector,

Since you have been banned for quite a large amount of time, I will accept your appeal. However, you are receiving the benefit of the doubt, as there is a possible chance of ban evasion between yourself and ASFFLUFFY710. However, since you claim that this person was your friend who you don't have connections to through minecraft anymore, I will unban you. Remember, if you are caught ban evading, you will be banned permanently and will not be allowed back onto the servers. Be sure to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back.

Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator
